scenes.tts: Take a bag or basket outdoors to collect eight to twelve fallen leaves that look different. Thin paper and a peeled crayon are for rubbings.
scenes.narration: Take a bag or basket outdoors to collect eight to twelve fallen leaves that look different. Thin paper and a peeled crayon are for rubbings.

scenes.tts: On a walk of ten to fifteen minutes, pick up fallen leaves only. Lay them out and look closely at the edges. Sort them one feature at a time. Then older children write yes or no questions to make a key.
scenes.narration: On a walk of ten to fifteen minutes, pick up fallen leaves only. Lay them out and look closely at the edges. Sort them one feature at a time. Then older children write yes or no questions to make a key.

scenes.tts: Colour is a poor feature, since one leaf can be green, red, or yellow. Edges, lobes, and leaflets work better.
scenes.narration: Colour is a poor feature, since one leaf can be green, red, or yellow. Edges, lobes, and leaflets work better.

scenes.tts: Do not touch any leaf made of three leaflets. Leave it on the ground, because poison ivy grows across Virginia.
